topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Workforce use rules and sanctions in POL-02 Parts A.4 and C
gap: No signed acknowledgments yet
remediation: Collect signed acknowledgments from all 7 employees and current contractors

gap: Oversight just started; no record yet; no independent board member
remediation: Keep monthly notes; add security to the quarterly investor update

evidence: eQMS training records; video completion list
gap: No annual or secure development training

control_description: Sanctions rule (POL-02 A.4); control owners named in the SSP and POA&M
gap: Accountability defined but not yet exercised
remediation: Review owners' progress at the monthly meeting

control_description: Inventory and SBOM planned (POL-04 4.4)
gap: No inventory of units, cloud resources, or software components
remediation: Inventory in the eQMS; SBOM in CI (POAM-005)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies in the eQMS available to all staff; reporting rule in POL-03 4.2
gap: Policies approved 2026-08-31; not yet communicated in training
remediation: Policy briefing for all staff; reporting card at each desk and in the lab

control_description: Security contact and CVD policy for outsiders; partner hospital contacts in the development agreement
gap: No published security contact or CVD policy
remediation: Publish CVD policy and security contact (POAM-006)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk tolerance and acceptance authority in POL-02 A.3; objectives tied to the submission schedule
2026 risk assessment with SP 800-30 (P01): 24 risks, owners, treatments
Fraud scenarios considered in P01 (R-012 payment diversion)

remediation: Call-back verification (POL-02 C.6) in use; add insider misuse of signing to the July 2027 assessment

control_description: Risk update at design freeze and before submission (POL-02 A.2)
gap: No change-triggered assessment has happened yet
remediation: Run the design-freeze risk update

control_description: Independent control assessment 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12 (P07); annual thereafter (POL-02 A.6)
Deficiencies tracked in the P07 POA&M with owners and dates; reviewed monthly by the CEO

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP from the Moderate baseline plus FDA-driven additions (P02)
gap: 15 of 45 controls only planned
remediation: Complete the POA&M and SSP planned controls

control_description: General IT controls through the MSP (laptops) and engineers (repository, cloud)
gap: Engineering systems outside the MSP contract have no routine controls
remediation: Lab workstations to the MSP (POAM-010); monthly engineering checklist

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-02, POL-03, POL-04 approved 2026-08-31; secure product development procedure planned
gap: Procedures under the policies not yet written (offboarding checklist, release procedure)
remediation: Write the checklist and release procedure

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: MFA on the suite, eQMS, repository, and named cloud accounts; TLS on all interfaces
gap: Shared cloud owner account; hubs share one API key and one maintenance password
remediation: Named roles and break-glass account (POAM-002); per-device credentials (POAM-004)

control_description: Accounts created on request by the MSP or engineers
gap: No approvals or checklist (P07 AC-2)
remediation: Onboarding checklist with written approval (POAM-001)

control_description: Access removed by email to the MSP for the suite only
gap: Former contractor kept repository access 5 months; no reviews
remediation: Offboarding checklist and monthly reconciliation (POAM-001, POAM-012)

control_description: Building badge access; keyed suite with alarm; signing key backup in the office safe; cloud data centers under the provider's SOC 2
evidence: Lease terms; key log; cloud provider SOC 2 review

control_description: Disposal rule in POL-04 4.9
gap: No disposal records yet; returned evaluation units not yet covered by a procedure
remediation: Disposal and reflash records

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewall blocks inbound traffic; cloud endpoints behind provider TLS termination
gap: Flat lab network; hub maintenance page exposed on site networks
remediation: Lab segmentation (POAM-010); maintenance page off by default (POAM-004)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS on hub-to-cloud and SaaS; encryption rule in POL-04 4.2
gap: Unauthenticated BLE pairing; secrets sent to the contract manufacturer by shared link
remediation: Authenticated BLE (P01 R-004); authenticated transfer (POAM-011)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on laptops; signed firmware verified at boot and update
evidence: EDR console export; P07 SI-7 test
gap: No protection on the lab workstations that flash units
remediation: Lab workstations under MSP EDR (POAM-010)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Dependency alerts on cloud code; MSP patch reports
gap: No monitoring of device components; no scanning; 14 alerts unanalyzed
remediation: SBOM-based monitoring and scanning (POAM-006)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Cloud activity and repository logs exist
gap: Nobody reviews logs; 90-day retention
remediation: Monthly log review; alerts on owner-role use (SSP AU-6)

control_description: Incident log and eQMS security record (POL-03 4.3)
gap: Procedure defined; no events recorded yet
remediation: Record every event, including CVD reports

control_description: P08 runbook approved 2026-08-31; tabletop 2026-08-27
gap: Runbook depends on one signer and on reflashing every unit to rotate keys
remediation: POAM-003, POAM-004; next tabletop before commercial distribution

control_description: Recovery order in the BIA and runbook
gap: No restore ever tested; environment built by hand
remediation: Infrastructure as code and restore test (POAM-009)

control_description: Design change procedure; main-branch review
gap: Releases cut by hand; cloud console changes unrecorded
remediation: Release pipeline with records (POAM-003); infrastructure changes through the repository

control_description: BIA approved; contingency plan planned
gap: No contingency plan
remediation: Short contingency plan from the BIA (SSP CP-2)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Quality agreement with the contract manufacturer; cloud provider SOC 2 reviewed 2026-08-24

remediation: Security terms (POAM-011); request SOC 2 reports from the repository and eQMS vendors

control_description: Cloud service uses provider-managed scaling; capacity is not an issue at pre-production load

remediation: Set capacity and availability targets in the design inputs before design freeze

control_description: Daily database snapshots (7 days); provider infrastructure resilience per its SOC 2
evidence: Snapshot settings; cloud provider SOC 2 review
gap: Short retention; same region; no clinical RTO and RPO set

gap: No recovery test
